subject: Clarify VAT handling + corrected invoice for November usage
messages:
From: Marta Kaczynski <marta@retailplatform.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: VAT treatment for Nov invoice — are you able to net VAT for us?

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick question from accounting: RetailPlatform is a B2B purchaser in Poland and we'd like the November invoice to be issued without Polish VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism if possible. Our VAT registration is active — I can attach the certificate.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood issue the invoice net (no VAT) if we provide the VAT ID?
- If yes, will the invoice need any special wording or place-of-supply line items from you (we need to record reverse-charge on our side)?

I attached the purchase order and a sample draft invoice that our AP team prefers. We're on a monthly cadence and would like to pay as soon as the corrected invoice is available.

Thanks,
Marta
Finance Operations | RetailPlatform Inc.
attachments: purchase_order_RF-2026-1482.pdf (document/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kaczynski <marta@retailplatform.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:03:00+01:00
Subject: RE: VAT treatment for Nov invoice — are you able to net VAT for us?

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the note and for the PO. Short answers up front: yes, we can reissue the invoice net of VAT for B2B EU customers that provide a valid VAT ID; and yes, we include explicit reverse-charge wording and place-of-supply lines per Polish requirements.

What we'll need from you to proceed:
- Confirm RetailPlatform's EU VAT number (exact string) and attach a copy of the VAT certificate or a VIES lookup screenshot.
- Confirm billing entity (Legal name and VAT country) that will appear on the invoice.

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa will prepare a corrected invoice (net of VAT) and add the reverse-charge note.
- We'll hold payment instructions until ID is validated — Ben will confirm collection release time.

I've attached a draft invoice for reference (provisional amounts only). Once we receive your VAT proof we'll create the final invoice and send a payment-ready PDF.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: invoice_draft_20261101.pdf (invoice/pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kaczynski <marta@retailplatform.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:45:00+01:00
Subject: RE: VAT treatment for Nov invoice — are you able to net VAT for us?

Hi Marta —

Thanks. When you send the VAT certificate, we'll run it through our accounts team and the VIES check. For the invoice content, we'll do the following so your AP can post it to Poland's ledger:

Invoice line-item approach (we will):
- Show gross amounts per product line (token usage, dedicated capacity surcharge)
- VAT column: 0% with footnote "Reverse charge — VAT payable by the recipient under Art. 196 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC"
- Place of supply: "Poland" (for your VAT reporting)
- Reference your VAT number and our Tax ID on the header

Please send:
1) VAT certificate PDF or screenshot of VIES confirmation
2) Full legal billing name and address to be printed on the invoice (if different from the PO)

We aim to reissue within one business day of validation. Ben — once validated, can Collections release the payment link and waive any temporary hold?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

I've attached the revised invoice (revised_invoice_20261101.pdf). It includes:

Marta — you should have a payment link in your vendor portal now (also sent to accounts@retailplatform.com). Let me know if AP needs the invoice in XML or Peppol format for your local system and we can generate that.
